scope.review_boundary: Report/configuration review only. No B3 evaluator, native capsule, private Kaggle job, submission, or production policy authority was created.

knowledge_base.binding_result: Known revealed/inaccessible copies are removed from live outs; unknown zones remain probabilistic; finite counts are without replacement; low deck count is not deck-out proof; CABT current legal semantics outrank tabletop assumptions; RQ-004/RQ-005/RQ-007 and CON-001/CON-002 remain unresolved.

checks: Actual PublicStateV1/EngineObservationV1/SelectionRequestV1 fields were compared; parent_entity_key is the exact entity field, terminal observations discard the request, and ongoing requests must match battle_id/transition_id/acting_player.
ResourceLedgerSeedV1 hidden_slot_counts are treated as zone capacities only; visible card/zone rows are public counts and do not identify hidden cards.
Complete LegalOptionV1 semantic fields, canonical fingerprints, availability, and request ordering are required; original_index/transport order are integrity-only.
STOP is a compound-action builder token governed by request bounds, not a LegalOptionV1 row.

deck_and_card_receipts.finding: The exact Mega Abomasnow profile and numeric CardTable metadata are static capacities/identity only. No ex/mega_ex flag or static attack row is accepted as PrizeStatic or effect proof.

formulations.A: Hard known-copy reserve floor and lexicographic preservation; unknown copies never increase reserve and no probability ordering is used.
formulations.B: Finite without-replacement public count-state probability after the same hard floor; it can diverge only with exact rational math and an explicit local-delta/route receipt.
formulations.divergence_requirement: B3-F01 must materialize exact reserve vectors, N/K/h or finite count states, route predicate, opportunity costs, and Fraction numerator/denominator values that make A and B select different non-equivalent options. Missing values are an implementation blocker, not a passing fixture.

required_invariants: Each public physical copy is counted once and identified by a source observation/event digest.
Hidden deck/hand/Prize lengths are capacities, not identities.
Unknown copies cannot satisfy a hard reserve floor.
A revealed/inaccessible copy is removed once and never double-counted across event and entity snapshots.

probability_model.math: Simple hits use 1 - C(N-K,h)/C(N,h); multiple roles use exact multivariate-hypergeometric count-state enumeration with rational arithmetic.
probability_model.provenance: DeckProfileV1, current PublicStateV1/request, exact route requirement and exact local-delta receipt; no engine RNG or successor observation.
probability_model.hidden_allocation_rule: If ordering changes across legal hidden allocations, B3-B returns UNKNOWN/B0_DELEGATE. A uniform hidden-allocation prior or guessed Prize map is not implicit; a future prior requires a separately approved belief experiment.

fail_closed_and_fixtures.delegation: Unknown/missing/partial capability, missing PrizeStatic, incomplete options, unsupported compound/ordering, unresolved STOP, stale lifecycle, hidden identity requirement, non-equivalent tie, or nonfinite probability delegates to B0 with a separate counter; it is not final-adapter fallback.
fail_closed_and_fixtures.fixtures: F01-F06 now require complete public option sets, semantic permutations, player mirror, fresh-process lifecycle/error/worker replacement, explicit STOP/compound traces, exact count/probability evidence, and independent recalculation.

capability_and_prize_blockers.prize_static: Missing. CardStatic ex/mega_ex flags are insufficient; a version-bound PrizeStaticV1 receipt is required before native use.
capability_and_prize_blockers.route_receipts: 1042/1043/1046/1262 remain PASS only within sealed route bounds; primary Frost Barrier 754:1089 is narrow; 1044/1045, 722-to-723 evolution/status/local delta, and generalization remain unqualified.
capability_and_prize_blockers.runtime: B3 evaluator source/config/import/transitive receipt and fresh-process native boundary qualification are absent. Uncommitted B1/B2 capability artifacts are explicitly excluded from authority.

statistics_and_runtime_audit.arm_execution: Two independent two-arm B0-compatible runs, B3-A versus a fresh B0 control and B3-B versus a fresh B0 control; no control reuse across formulations.
statistics_and_runtime_audit.estimand: Equal fixed-weight mean of the eight anchor x candidate-seat cell candidate-minus-control deltas; pooled all-game WDL is descriptive only.
statistics_and_runtime_audit.sampling: Independent native games, candidate-perspective terminal WDL, natural deployment with balanced candidate seats, no paired-seed or trajectory claim, forced first/second diagnostics separate.
statistics_and_runtime_audit.promotion_floor: Experimental challenger only after zero hard counters, activation >=32 decisions and >=5 percent at confirmation, no catastrophic cell regression, and equal-cell confirmation lower 95 percent interval > +0.02 with point estimate at least B0. No deck freeze/champion/submission authority.
statistics_and_runtime_audit.runtime: Candidate-only callback CPU/wall/RSS and cardinality must be measured; 600 cumulative CPU seconds/game and 8 GiB RSS are hard safety caps; no delegation may hide candidate latency.

report_only_corrections: Excluded seven observed uncommitted B1/B2 capability and fixture paths from semantic/native authority.
Corrected the entity field list to the actual parent_entity_key and made the public ledger row categories/invariants explicit.
Added exact B3-B probability provenance/math, rational arithmetic, and the no-unapproved-hidden-prior rule.
Made F01-F06 materialization requirements falsifiable rather than prose-only.
Replaced ambiguous three-arm budgeting with two independent formulation-vs-fresh-control runs and an explicit eight-cell estimand.
Aligned challenger activation and +0.02 confirmation floors with the existing B1/B2 comparison discipline.

readiness.next_exact_task: Implement only an isolated B3-A/B fixture evaluator and tests, materialize F01-F06 with exact public count states and rational probability evidence, run fresh-process permutation/lifecycle/player-mirror review, and stop before native work unless every prerequisite passes.
